reviews.comment: Professor Norris is great, not an option here but I was in his 203 class. It was made up basically of only essays which were graded harshly. He changed lectures and in class information to help us do better and tell us what needs to happen for us to succeed. My classmates didnt want to talk. He is really funny but also super straight to the point.

Dr.Norris is great. His classes are boring and attendance is required. Most of his grades come from in class assignments and group work. He is not bad but for the assignments you have to be in class. The final is an 8-10 page research paper so beware of that, he does help you on it though. Overall just show up and you'd get an A!!

Take him!! Most of his grades are just completion grades from in-class assignments or discussion boards. He only actually grades three essays throughout the semester and as long as you do decent on them you will get an A. The only downside would be that attendance is mandatory for the in-class assignment grades.

Prof Norris is awesome! Literally the chillest guy ever. Half the credit is honestly just form showing up and doing in class work. The papers can be pretty time consuming but as long as you put in an effort you'll be fine. He also gives extra credit on each paper for going to the UWC. There aren't a ton of lectures but you do work with groups alot.
